responsibility: Implements Darwin-specific C-family frontend hooks. It registers and parses Apple pragmas such as #pragma options align, #pragma unused, and #pragma ms_struct; manages Objective-C include and framework header search behavior including subframework resolution; defines Darwin preprocessor builtins like __APPLE__ and the deployment-target macro derived from -mmacosx-version-min; handles C-family options such as -iframework and -fapple-kext; and provides Objective-C string-object hooks for constant CFString construction, CFString format recognition, and NeXT runtime class-reference top-level asm emission.
